name: mpa
description: Multi-party approval is a capability of Organizations that allows you to protect a predefined list of operations through a distributed approval process.

subcommands.name: cancel-session
subcommands.description: Cancels an approval session.

subcommands.name: create-approval-team
subcommands.description: Creates a new approval team.

subcommands.name: create-identity-source
subcommands.description: Creates a new identity source.

subcommands.name: delete-identity-source
subcommands.description: Deletes an identity source.

subcommands.name: delete-inactive-approval-team-version
subcommands.description: Deletes an inactive approval team.

subcommands.name: get-approval-team
subcommands.description: Returns details for an approval team.

subcommands.name: get-identity-source
subcommands.description: Returns details for an identity source.

subcommands.name: get-policy-version
subcommands.description: Returns details for the version of a policy.

subcommands.name: get-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Returns details about a policy for a resource.

subcommands.name: get-session
subcommands.description: Returns details for an approval session.

subcommands.name: list-approval-teams
subcommands.description: Returns a list of approval teams.

subcommands.name: list-identity-sources
subcommands.description: Returns a list of identity sources.

subcommands.name: list-policies
subcommands.description: Returns a list of policies.

subcommands.name: list-policy-versions
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the versions for policies.

subcommands.name: list-resource-policies
subcommands.description: Returns a list of policies for a resource.

subcommands.name: list-sessions
subcommands.description: Returns a list of approval sessions.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the tags for a resource.

subcommands.name: start-active-approval-team-deletion
subcommands.description: Starts the deletion process for an active approval team.

subcommands.name: start-approval-team-baseline
subcommands.description: Starts a baseline session for specified approvers on an ACTIVE approval team.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Creates or updates a resource tag.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes a resource tag.

subcommands.name: update-approval-team
subcommands.description: Updates an approval team.
